title: Softbody
body:
SoftBody is a physics based Minecraft mod that makes the game world feel alive through smooth wobbling, shaking, bouncing, and soft motion effects. Movement, impacts, explosions, and interactions all gain reactive animation that adds a dynamic and chaotic feel to gameplay while still keeping Minecraft recognizable.

Instead of everything feeling stiff and rigid, SoftBody introduces procedural motion systems that make entities and environmental reactions feel more fluid and expressive. The mod focuses on visual polish, satisfying motion, and playful physics inspired effects that work naturally during normal gameplay.

Features include:

Smooth wobble and shake effects
Reactive motion during movement and impacts
Soft physics inspired animation systems
Dynamic visual feedback for gameplay interactions
Multiplayer friendly design
Configurable settings for effect intensity

SoftBody is designed for players who want Minecraft to feel more animated, energetic, and fun without completely changing the core experience.

Requirements

SoftBody requires the following dependencies:

[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

[Kotlin for Fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)

[Waiter API](https://modrinth.com/project/uP48BAfM)

Make sure all required dependencies are installed before launching the game.
